scenario: LCYC.3.2.2's emit edge reaches a `call`'s continuation body: `ra` matches an `A` and, in the call's `on response` body, emits a `B`; `rb` matches the `B` and emits an `A`. The `emit B` is an ordinary emit edge ra -> rb, because the response decides when it runs and not whether it is an emit, so the two rules form one SCC with `A` emitted and matched inside it (LCYC.3.1.1). Refused with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. PATH PINNED: `dsc.cycle.rhs_actions` descending into an `on` body. Without that descent `ra` emits nothing, the graph is acyclic, and the program compiles.
rules_ds:
schema GoReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service s.go:
    kwarg n: Int
    response GoReply

schema A scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema B scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule ra:
    A a
->
    call s.go n: a.v cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            emit B v: a.v

rule rb:
    B b
->
    emit A v: b.v
